introContent.title: What is the suffix -sion?
introContent.meaningStatement: -sion turns an action into the name of the action or result.
paragraphs: A suffix is a group of letters added to the end of a word.
The suffix -sion usually means the action, process or result of.
It often changes a verb into a noun — a naming word.
spellingRules: -sion is often used after words ending in -d or -de: decide → decision.
It can also be used after -s or -se: confuse → confusion, and after -mit: admit → admission.
Sometimes -sion sounds like “zhun”, as in decision, vision and explosion.
decide → decision: a decision is the choice you make after deciding.
divide → division; confuse → confusion; revise → revision; expand → expansion.
Look for s-i-o-n together at the end of the finished word.
